S2D4P.preprocessing.preprocessing module

class S2D4P.preprocessing.preprocessing.PreprocessingPipeline(preprocessors_list: list[~S2D4P.preprocessing.selector.PreprocessingStepSelector] = <factory>, load_dir: str | ~pathlib.Path | None = None)

Bases: object

Manage an ordered sequence of preprocessing transformations.

The pipeline constructs preprocessing modules from configured selectors, fits them sequentially, applies forward and inverse transformations, stores reference output coordinates and variables, and supports serialization of fitted preprocessing state.

Parameters:

  • preprocessors_list (list[PreprocessingStepSelector]) – Ordered preprocessing steps used to construct the pipeline.

  • load_dir (str | Path | None) – Path to a previously saved preprocessing pipeline. If provided, fitted pipeline state is restored during initialization.

Notes

Below arguments are configured to be read from configs and not specified by user. This can be changed if adopting the code for other pipelines.

init_time_dimstr

Name of the initialization-time dimension used by the pipeline.

lead_time_dimstr

Name of the lead-time dimension used by the pipeline.

supported_NN_dimensionstuple[str, …]

Ordered dimensions supported as neural-network output dimensions.

add_fitted_preprocessor(preprocessor, name, index=None)

Add a fitted preprocessing module to the pipeline.

Parameters:

  • preprocessor (Any) – Fitted preprocessing module to add.

  • name (str) – Name associated with the preprocessing step.

  • index (int | None) – Position at which to insert the preprocessor. If None, the preprocessor is appended.

Raises:

AssertionError – If preprocessor has not been fitted.

extract_output_coords_vars(base_data: Dataset | DataArray | None = None)

Record reference output coordinates and variables.

Supported neural-network dimensions are extracted from the fitting data and stored for later reconstruction of model outputs.

Parameters:

base_data (xr.Dataset | xr.DataArray) – Data from which reference coordinates and variable names are extracted.

Raises:

ValueError – If the pipeline is not fitted, no supported neural-network dimensions are present, or the fitting data contain no data variables.

fit(base_data: Dataset | DataArray | None = None, mask: DataArray | None = None, save: bool = True, save_name: str | None = None, save_path: Path | str | None = None)

Fit the preprocessing pipeline sequentially.

Each preprocessing module is fitted on the output of the preceding transformation. Reference output coordinates and variables are recorded after all steps are fitted, and the fitted pipeline can optionally be serialized.

Parameters:

  • base_data (xr.Dataset | xr.DataArray) – Data used to fit the preprocessing pipeline.

  • mask (xr.DataArray | None) – Optional mask applied while fitting preprocessing statistics.

  • save (bool) – Whether to save the fitted pipeline to disk.

  • save_name (str | None) – Filename used when saving the pipeline. If None, a name is generated from the pipeline identifier.

  • save_path (Path | str | None) – Directory in which the fitted pipeline is saved. If None, the experiment preprocessing directory is used.

Returns:

This fitted preprocessing pipeline.

Return type:

PreprocessingPipeline

class S2D4P.preprocessing.preprocessing_ABC.PreprocessModuleABC

Bases: ABC

Abstract base class for preprocessing modules.

Defines the common interface for fitting, transforming, and inverse transforming xarray data, together with shared utilities for temporal grouping, reduction dimensions, and validation.

class S2D4P.preprocessing.utils_preprocessing.AnomaliesScaler(dims: list[str] | None = None, frequency: Literal['day', 'month', 'year'] | None = None, **kwargs)

Bases: PreprocessModuleABC

Convert data to anomalies relative to a fitted mean.

The mean is calculated over configurable dimensions and can optionally be estimated separately by year, month, or day.

Parameters:

  • dims (list[str] | None) – Dimensions over which the mean is calculated.

  • frequency (TemporalFrequency | None) – Optional temporal frequency used to group fitted means.

  • kwargs (Any) – Additional unused keyword arguments accepted for pipeline compatibility.

fit(data: Dataset | DataArray, mask: DataArray | None = None)

Fit mean values used to calculate anomalies.

An optional mask excludes values from fitting. When temporal grouping is enabled and initialization time is reduced, a separate mean is fitted for each temporal group.

  • mask (xr.DataArray | None) – Optional mask identifying values excluded from fitting.

class S2D4P.preprocessing.utils_preprocessing.Flattennanremove(load_dir: str | Path | None = None, **kwargs)

Bases: PreprocessModuleABC

Flatten neural-network dimensions while removing invalid locations.

Supported neural-network dimensions are stacked into a single ref dimension. Only locations containing valid data are retained. When both input and target data are supplied, only locations valid in both are preserved.

Parameters:

  • load_dir (Path | str | None) – Path to a previously fitted flattening preprocessor.

  • kwargs (Any) – Additional unused keyword arguments accepted for pipeline compatibility.

fit(data: Dataset | DataArray, target: Dataset | DataArray | None = None, mask=None, save: bool = False, save_name: str | None = None, save_path: str | Path | None = None)

Fit the valid flattened locations.

Neural-network dimensions are stacked into a ref dimension and locations containing missing values are removed. When a target is provided, retained locations are restricted to those valid in both input and target data.

Parameters:

  • data (xr.Dataset | xr.DataArray) – Input data used to determine valid flattened locations.

  • target (xr.Dataset | xr.DataArray | None) – Optional target data used to restrict locations to those valid in both input and target datasets.

  • mask (Any) – Optional mask argument accepted for preprocessing pipeline compatibility. It is not used by this preprocessor.

  • save (bool) – Whether to serialize the fitted preprocessor.

  • save_name (str | None) – Base filename used when saving the fitted preprocessor.

  • save_path (Path | str | None) – Directory in which the fitted preprocessor is saved.

Returns:

This fitted flattening preprocessor.

Return type:

Flattennanremove

Raises:

RuntimeError – If input data do not contain all neural-network dimensions required by the reference data.

class S2D4P.preprocessing.utils_preprocessing.Standardizer(dims: list[str] | None = None, frequency: Literal['day', 'month', 'year'] | None = None, **kwargs)

Bases: PreprocessModuleABC

Standardize data using fitted mean and standard deviation.

Statistics are calculated over the configured dimensions and can optionally be grouped by year, month, or day. Locations with zero standard deviation are masked because they cannot be standardized.

Parameters:

  • dims (list[str] | None) – Dimensions over which mean and standard deviation are calculated.

  • frequency (TemporalFrequency | None) – Optional temporal frequency used to group fitted statistics.

  • kwargs (Any) – Additional unused keyword arguments accepted for pipeline compatibility.

Notes

Fitted standard deviations that are not greater than zero are replaced with missing values and therefore remain masked during transformation.

fit(data: Dataset | DataArray, mask: DataArray | None = None)

Fit mean and sample standard-deviation statistics.

An optional mask excludes values from fitting. When temporal grouping is enabled and initialization time is reduced, separate statistics are fitted for each temporal group. Standard deviations that are not positive are masked.

Parameters:

  • data (xr.Dataset | xr.DataArray) – Data used to estimate standardization statistics.

  • mask (xr.DataArray | None) – Optional mask identifying values excluded from fitting.

class S2D4P.preprocessing.utils_preprocessing.TrendRemover(frequency: Literal['month', 'day'] | None = None, **kwargs)

Bases: PreprocessModuleABC

Remove a fitted linear temporal trend from data.

A linear trend is fitted along initialization time. Trends can be fitted globally or separately by month or day-of-year.

Parameters:

  • frequency (Literal["month", "day"] | None) – Optional temporal grouping frequency. If None, one trend is fitted across all initialization times.

  • kwargs (Any) – Additional unused keyword arguments accepted for pipeline compatibility.

TEMPORAL_ORDER: ClassVar[dict] = {'day': 0, 'month': 1, 'year': 2}
fit(data: Dataset, mask: DataArray | None = None)

Fit linear temporal trends.

  • mask (xr.DataArray | None) – Optional mask identifying values excluded from fitting.

Returns:

This fitted trend remover.

Return type:

TrendRemover

S2D4P.preprocessing.utils_preprocessing.align_stat_data_lead_time_inverse_transform(ds: DataArray | Dataset, stat: DataArray | Dataset, lead_time_resolution: Literal['day', 'month'] = 'month', init_time_dim: str = 'time', lead_time_dim: str = 'lead_time') → DataArray | Dataset

Align preprocessing statistics with data for inverse transformation.

Statistics containing a lead-time dimension are aligned using initialization times. Otherwise, forecast valid times are used.

Temporal grouping dimensions (‘year’, ‘month’, ‘day’) are aligned to the appropriate temporal coordinates.

Parameters:

  • ds (xr.DataArray | xr.Dataset) – Data to be inverse-transformed.

  • stat (xr.DataArray | xr.Dataset) – Fitted preprocessing statistics.

  • lead_time_resolution (lead_time_unit) – Resolution of forecast lead times.

  • init_time_dim (str) – Initialization-time dimension name.

  • lead_time_dim (str) – Lead-time dimension name.

Returns:

Temporally aligned statistics.

Return type:

xr.DataArray | xr.Dataset
